The Plugins p"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"age in the Web UI installs the same package."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"From a checkout, for development:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Requires DSH 0.2.x and `python` on `PATH` — the plugin does not probe for an interpreter.
Swap `web`"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" for the profile you actually run."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Every call is one program."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Field | What it is for |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `code` | the program, executed verbatim through stdin |
| `workdir` | working directory; defaults "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"to the session's current one, and a relative path resolves against it |
| `save_to` | save the sourc"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"e to a file before the run; atomic, parent directories created, fenced by the session's file policy "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"|
| `timeout_ms` | foreground budget; rejected together with a background run |
| `run_in_background"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"` | returns a job id at once; no timeout applies |
| `sandbox_permissions` + `justification` | one-s"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"hot retry of a call the sandbox just denied |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Output is stdout, then a `[stderr]` section, then markers: `[saved to <path>]`, `[exit code: N]`
(a "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"non-zero exit is a result, not a failure), `[timed out after Nms]`, `[killed by signal: …]`,
`[outpu"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"t truncated; full output: <path>]`, `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`save_to` writes through the session filesystem, so the session's file policy decides: refused
under"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" `read-only`, confined to the workspace under `workspace-write`, and — in a deployment that
enables "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"the read-before-write policy — refused when the target exists and this session has not
read it. The "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"save happens before the program starts: a refused save never runs anything, and a
returned job id me"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ans the file is already on disk."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Background jobs appear in `job_list` with kind `python`, are read with `job_output`, and
stopped wit"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"bs appear in `job_list` with kind `python`, are read with `job_output`, and
stopped with `job_kill`."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Limits"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- A foreground timeout kills the program; it never promotes to a background job. For long
work, pass"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" `run_in_background` on the first call.
- The program cannot read interactive input — stdin carries "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"the source.
- A saved file is not the same execution environment: `python -` runs with `sys.path[0]`"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" at the
cwd and `__file__` as `<stdin>`; running the same file from disk later changes both (imports"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"
of sibling modules start resolving).
- No config surface: the executor's own defaults and caps deci"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"de timeouts and output limits."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## More"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Runtime contract, dependency placement, release process, and the "every tool call fails"
